title: Citizen jury
invited: You were drawn for the citizen jury.
inviteText: {n, plural, one {One person reviews} other {# people review}} a report, anonymously and in about 3 minutes.
question: Does this post break the rule?
hardCritique: Harsh criticism of an idea is allowed.
upheld: The majority of the jury decided: violation. The post is hidden; the context remains readable. Both sides receive a calm message.
dismissed: The majority of the jury decided: no violation. The post stays visible.
waiting: Your vote is counted. The result is final once the majority of the jury has decided.
